# FarmRent

> FarmRent is a farm equipment rental platform connecting farmers with equipment owners and providing access to agro products.

## About FarmRent

FarmRent makes it easier for farmers to find and access agricultural equipment for their farming needs.

Equipment owners can list their machines and make them available to farmers looking for equipment to rent.

FarmRent also provides access to agro products and agricultural resources.

FarmRent is operated by Domsal&Bonks Nigeria Limited.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://yourdomain.com/index.html): FarmRent homepage and overview of available services.
- [Equipment](https://yourdomain.com/equipment.html): Browse farm equipment available through FarmRent.
- [Agro Products](https://yourdomain.com/agro-products.html): Explore agricultural products and resources.
- [About](https://yourdomain.com/about.html): Learn more about FarmRent and how the platform operates.
- [Help](https://yourdomain.com/help.html): Find answers and assistance about using FarmRent.
- [List Equipment](https://yourdomain.com/list-equipment.html): Information and access for equipment owners who want to list their machines.

## Equipment Rental

FarmRent allows users to browse farm equipment and explore rental options.

Equipment listings may include tractors, power tillers, irrigation systems, combine harvesters, and other agricultural equipment.

## Equipment Owners

Equipment owners can use FarmRent to list their agricultural machines and make them available to farmers who need them.

## Agro Products

FarmRent includes an agro products section where users can explore agricultural products and resources.

## Important Notes

FarmRent is a frontend web platform. Information about equipment, availability, rental prices, products, and other services should be treated as information provided through the website.

For the most current information, refer to the relevant FarmRent page.
